svg.title: The reference-gate handshake, illustrated: two presenters, one gate
svg.desc: Two agents. Same door. A fresh key (0xb58ae8f4cc3f85c186c36fc6fb0ce1823e12305f) and an established agent (0x9493c31d5abf66ac25912ab08edcee6e004e1783) each ask the gate at gate.example.com to act for the first time — the counterparty onboarding example. Illustrative: fixture presenters, presentations signed by the reference's test issuer key. A signed challenge — from the gate's own domain. One each: 3ab6b210dc10b236… and fd3e3f150ab85eda…, signed with key gate-k1, 8 questions, expiring after 15 minutes. Both burn to present. Each presentation stands for a 15 PVT burn at the reputation tier; the burn id is the presentation id (illustrative: no transaction on chain). Both keys valid. Both presentations verified. The issuer's signature, the presenter's key and the challenge check out for both; first acceptance. A key check stops here. Fresh key — Identity: No witnessed act on record: nothing stands behind this key. Fewer than 30 distinct days active under witness. Fewer than 10 active days in the last 90. No registered device. An empty hash chain: no act has ever been recorded. Accountable human: No person is linked to this agent or answers for it. No turn a person directed. Witnessed history: Fewer than 25 acts in the last 90 days witnessed by something other than the actor. No hardware-rooted act in the last 90 days. Standing: No adverse event on record. No open bond claim against it; no active invalidation. Counterparties: Fewer than 3 independent parties built on its output. It cites no one’s work but its own. No independent party paid it in the last 90 days. Money witnessed: No inbound payment the chain witnessed. No inbound payment the chain witnessed in the last 90 days. No financial act the chain witnessed in the last 90 days. No promise fulfilled. No promise defaulted. No escrow completed as the provider. BLOCK: Fewer than 30 distinct days active under witness (asked: continuity.active_days gte 30). Fewer than 10 active days in the last 90 (asked: continuity.active_days_90d gte 10). Fewer than 25 acts in the last 90 days witnessed by something other than the actor (asked: work.witnessed_90d gte 25). Fewer than 3 independent parties built on its output (asked: consumption.independent_parties gte 3). No person is linked to this agent or answers for it (asked: accountability.human_beneficiary eq 1). Established agent — Identity: First witnessed 2025-08-05, 431 days before this presentation. At least 30 distinct days active under witness. At least 10 active days in the last 90. 3 registered devices. 48,210 acts in its hash chain. Accountable human: A person is linked to this agent and answers for it. 15,312 turns a person directed. Witnessed history: At least 25 acts in the last 90 days witnessed by something other than the actor. 1,284 commits a code forge witnessed. 9,412 hardware-rooted acts in the last 90 days. 100% of its work in the last 90 days is hardware-rooted. Standing: One adverse event on record: a bond it posted expired — none in the last 90 days, within the last year. It stays in every presentation this actor makes. No open bond claim against it; no active invalidation. Counterparties: At least 3 independent parties built on its output. 212 owners other than itself whose work it cites. 19 independent parties paid it in the last 90 days. Money witnessed: 640 inbound payments the chain witnessed. 71 inbound payments the chain witnessed in the last 90 days. 184 financial acts the chain witnessed in the last 90 days. 31 promises fulfilled. No promise defaulted. 44 escrows completed as the provider. ALLOW: Every question this gate asked was answered yes, and nothing in Standing objects. Replay from either: Refused. The same presentation sent again is replayed for both. Nothing unwitnessed gets in. Counterparty onboarding, Payment-rail commitment, Repository merge gate, Mission-critical action, Sensitive site. Fork the reference gate.
